articles.title: 11 Missing as Drone Attacks Strike Two Ships Near NATO Waters
articles.summary: A ship was reportedly sunk by a drone attack off Bulgaria's coast, leaving eleven sailors missing. This serious maritime incident underscores escalating regional security concerns, potentially being the second deadly cargo ship sinking. Such attacks highlight ongoing threats to shipping and the need for enhanced defence strategies in contested waters, a critical issue for national security and international stability.

articles.title: Indian Navy sailors visiting UK on training exercise are mistaken for migrants by anti-immigration protesters in Plymouth
articles.summary: Indian Navy personnel conducting a training exercise in Plymouth, UK, were mistakenly identified as migrants by local protesters and a 'patriots' group. This incident, involving sailors participating in an international defence engagement, underscores the need for clarity and awareness during joint exercises abroad. It highlights potential challenges when defence forces operate in foreign public spaces, even during routine training missions.

articles.title: NASA’s Perseverance Mars rover sets distance record
articles.summary: NASA's Perseverance Mars rover has set a new record, traveling an impressive 28.10 miles across the Martian surface. This milestone marks the longest distance covered by any vehicle on another planet, highlighting significant advancements in space exploration technology. The six-wheeled science lab continues its mission, providing invaluable data and pushing the boundaries of planetary scientific discovery.

articles.title: NASA Mars Rover Sets Record That Was 15 Years In The Making
articles.summary: NASA's Perseverance rover on Mars has set a new historic off-world driving record, traversing 28.10 km on the Martian surface. This significant achievement marks the farthest any vehicle in human history has traveled on another planetary body, surpassing previous records. It underscores advancements in space exploration technology and robotic endurance, contributing valuable data for future interplanetary missions and scientific understanding of Mars.

articles.title: What Supermarkets Cybersecurity Can Learn From Battlestar Galactica
articles.summary: Hundreds of French supermarkets faced a major cyberattack over the weekend, with hackers remotely controlling and heating refrigeration systems to 50°C. This malicious act caused widespread food spoilage and equipment damage. The incident underscores critical infrastructure vulnerabilities and the growing threat of cyber warfare, highlighting its potential impact on national security and economic stability.

articles.title: Travel history and occupation among diagnosed Cutaneous Leishmaniasis cases in Guyana: A multi-site retrospective case series, 2017–2021
articles.summary: A multi-site retrospective study in Guyana, referenced for 2026, investigates the travel history and occupation of individuals diagnosed with Cutaneous Leishmaniasis. This research, involving scientists like Kurup R and Roberts T, aims to understand the epidemiological factors influencing the disease's prevalence. Such studies are crucial for developing targeted public health strategies, identifying high-risk groups, and implementing effective prevention and control measures against this infectious skin condition in affected regions.
